correctness.rationale: The unique forced fixed-point partition and inverse construction are proved for all nonempty carriers, including empty auxiliary sets. Exact multinomial counting yields the formula without overcount. Matrix fibers classify isomorphisms and yield a split automorphism-group extension; a simple-cubic incidence model preserves exactly its underlying graph automorphisms by Frucht. One-idempotent models have rooted stars and cannot have odd nontrivial automorphism groups. Independent exhaustive n<=4 and three graph-instance brute-force checks passed.

value.rationale: A single elementary first-order axiom system with two unary operations has an explicit complete model classification and all-parameter labeled count, despite general hardness of two-function model counting. The same restricted class realizes every finite group and two idempotent symbols are sharp for universal realization. Exact structural/boundary outcomes are motivated and not an arbitrary numerical slice.
